accounting.rationale: Defines the general type concept: a named category coupled with type parameters to determine a value set, syntax for denoting values, and operations. Detailed value, literal, parameter, and operation obligations remain with 7.1, 7.2, 7.4, 7.5, 7.6, 7.8, and 10.1.5 catalogues; no representation or finite-domain oracle is introduced here.

Partitions types into intrinsic and nonintrinsic, and states the origins of nonintrinsic types. Intrinsic accessibility and nonintrinsic name accessibility are owned by 7.1.2; derived-type definitions by 7.5; intrinsic-module supplied types by their module catalogues.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4 and 5.4.1-5.4.6 of the Clause 5 overview: type, data value, data entity, data object, definition of objects and pointers, reference and array (batch249). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; overview definitions are cross-referenced to specific owning facets in Clauses 7-19. Source accounting only.
